subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

If she hadn't ______ her cell phone on the bed, she could have called him.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Thrown**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense, indicating that the action of not having her cell phone occurred before the missed opportunity to call.
 
• The correct verb form to use in this context is "**thrown**," which is the past participle form of "throw."
 
• The word "thrown" is used to indicate an action that has already happened in the past.
 
• When something is "**thrown**," it means it was propelled or tossed through the air with force or effort. (बल या प्रयास से हवा में उछाला या उछाला गया)
 
• "**Thrown**" is the correct option because it implies that she had her cell phone in her possession but misplaced it, hence not being able to call.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence**: *If she hadn't thrown __her cell phone on the bed, she could have called him.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Through**: From one end or side to the other; completed or finished. (एक छोर से दूसरे छोर तक; पूर्ण या समाप्त)
 
• **Throne**: A ceremonial chair used by a ruler or monarch; a symbol of royal authority. (शासक या राजा द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली एक औपचारिक कुर्सी; शाही अधिकार का प्रतीक)
 
• **Throng**: A large, densely packed crowd of people or objects; to gather or assemble in great numbers. (लोगों या वस्तुओं की एक बड़ी, घनी भीड़; बड़ी संख्या में एकत्र होना या एकत्र होना)
